question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**that**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate answer for the fifth blank is 'that'.
 
• The most appropriate title for the given blank is 'History of India's Space Journey'.
 
• In the given context, '**that**' is 'used to refer to a person, object, idea, etc. that is separated from the speaker by space or time'.
 
 
• *Example: I've never liked **that** cousin of hers.*

 
 
 

​Correct Passage:__ *In its 47 years of history, ISRO has done breakthrough work in the field of technology and even launched many vehicles into space. Over the last 47 years, ISRO has improvised and developed technology, launching several indigenously created vehicles into space **that** form a part of the Indian space journey.*
